name: Multiples — A Whole New Body After Orgasm
summary: Pretend you or your partner woke up in a completely new body after the first orgasm—fresh skin with entirely new likes and dislikes—and start from scratch to discover what feels good now. Used by about 47% of women who experience multiples.
detailed_description: This mindset technique treats the post-orgasm body as different from the pre-orgasm one. Immediately after climax the clit can be painful to touch, so you explore as if discovering preferences for the first time. Once the initial oversensitivity fades, a modified version of the techniques that worked for the first orgasm often works again.
stepwise_structure: 1. After the first orgasm, mentally reset—treat the body as brand new.
2. Avoid the clit at the moment of peak oversensitivity (it can hurt).
3. Explore gently from scratch to learn what feels good now.
4. Once oversensitivity fades, reintroduce a modified, gentler version of what worked the first time.
5. Build toward a second orgasm from there.
safety_notes: Don't touch the clit directly during peak post-orgasm sensitivity.
Let the receiver's current responses guide you, not the pre-orgasm map.
